basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Applied AI Engineer | LLM Ops & Platform Infrastructure | Python + TypeScript
basics.summary: Applied AI engineer with a platform bias. At LumApps I built the shared AI substrate the rest of the org now builds on: AI Brain (a temporal knowledge graph every agent reads and writes), eval pipelines, LangSmith tracing, and cost-per-request instrumentation across production multi-agent workflows. 13+ years shipping backend systems and developer tooling to 10M+ users, most recently in Python and TypeScript. I think in trade-offs (reliability, latency, cost, quality, maintainability) and I like making other engineers faster more than I like shipping single features.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Own the LLM Ops layer for production agents: eval pipelines, LangSmith tracing, cost-per-request instrumentation, tool-selection tuning, verification loops, and on-call. Same platform other product teams now build on top of.

Built AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes. Event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub, per-agent query and write-back contracts, freshness layer for stale-fact detection. Reusable across the platform.

Shipped the reference multi-agent workflow (Python, LangGraph, Google ADK on GCP Vertex AI, tools over MCP, state streamed to the UI over AG-UI): 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day, $1M forecast in quarterly revenue.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Designed a distributed templating engine (Java, Kafka) that cut customer setup time 90% and now powers 15% of all assets for 10M+ users. Reusable platform primitive other product teams standardize on.

Replaced a $337K annual vendor translation contract with an in-house LLM pipeline (GitHub Actions + OpenAI APIs) shipped in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated, product team iterates without external gatekeepers.

Ran observability and global on-call (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io, Langfuse for LLM traces): logs, metrics, dashboards, alerting. Diagnosed and fixed production issues across model, service, and infra layers.
Built and mentored the AI engineering cohort. Wrote the internal patterns, review bar, and eval tooling other engineers now reuse when shipping AI features independently.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer for an EPFL spin-off. Shipped the full autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL) that powered 500+ real-world deliveries.
Built cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline from scratch on AWS. Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled a Unilever partnership and a CES showcase.

publications.summary: How verification loops, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and draft-before-send patterns keep an autonomous agent from shipping wrong actions to real users.
